'''Murakai's Chest''' is the end of dungeon reward for the [[Cathedral of Flames]]. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one [[Exquisite Surmia Carving]], as well as one item from the following list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

==Location==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**[[Cathedral of Flames]] - Level 3
